title: Redeliver canonical documentation architecture from current main
rawUserRequest: Complete the attached AI Cockpit next-stage directive across all ten Work Items through archive, PR, merge, and branch cleanup. Redeliver WI07 from current main after its archived-unmerged predecessor became non-rebasable, without weakening quality or rewriting archive evidence.

declaredIntent.summary: Redeliver WI07's verified canonical documentation architecture from current main while preserving the superseded archive as immutable read-only evidence.

outOfScope: Rebasing, renumbering, merging, or editing the archived-unmerged WI07 evidence bundle
Changing runtime governance, installer behavior, calibration behavior, or quality routing
Implementing WI06 capability-claim binding, WI08 interactive installer UX, or WI09 external identity controls
Claiming historical plans or reviews are current product instructions

sources.reason: Bounded successor governance record for current-main delivery.
Historical implementation plan and successor delivery record; the superseded archive remains read-only on its branch and is not copied into this successor.
Existing documentation ownership and navigation authority to consolidate rather than duplicate.
Existing executable documentation metadata and public-fact validator.
Current overloaded public entry page targeted by WI07's README simplification rules.

riskAssessment.reason: The successor replays a reviewed public documentation and validator payload onto a newer base; broken links, duplicated authority, or accidental inclusion of superseded archive evidence could mislead adopters.

reasons: Documentation, metadata validation, public entrypoint, and validator changes require the automatically selected Standard route; Release behavior is unchanged.

executionDecision.reason: The successor path is mandated by archive recovery evidence; the prior payload and its corrective coverage are available as source-bound, read-only evidence.

preReviewWarnings: Confirm no superseded WI07 archive/index files enter the successor diff.
Confirm each current topic has one canonical owner and compatibility links do not become competing authority.
Confirm README remains a short entry page while detailed install and lifecycle evidence stays reachable.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The getting-started, concepts, operations, security, reference, and archive layers contain one canonical page per required WI07 topic plus compatibility routes for existing links.
Every WI07 canonical formal document carries valid audience, status, authority, and lastVerifiedBy metadata, and the executable metadata checker fails closed for missing or invalid values.

The English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese README entry pages contain only product identity, problem, evidence flow, three-color decision state, 30-second start, product boundary, and documentation entrypoints.
Detailed Release, Calibration, quality-gate, enterprise-control, historical-plan, and supply-chain implementation material is owned by canonical documentation routes outside the README files.
The successor diff excludes every archived-unmerged WI07 lifecycle artifact while preserving the old branch as read-only source evidence until replacement closure.
Focused documentation tests and changed-critical coverage pass on current main, and the Contract-selected Standard quality route passes.
guidelines: Keep one canonical owner for each current documentation fact and use compatibility links instead of duplicated authority.
Preserve multilingual public entry routes and executable documentation fact checks.
Do not import superseded archive/index/status artifacts into the successor delivery.
Do not change runtime, installer, release, or calibration behavior.

intent.problem: The original WI07 payload passed full quality and archived, but a post-archive PR coverage failure required a corrective that advanced main and consumed the same archive sequence. Archive recovery correctly prohibits rebasing that immutable bundle, while the repository still needs WI07's canonical documentation architecture.
constraints: Keep AI Cockpit within the Repository Governance Layer boundary and preserve Evidence over Self-Declaration.
Treat the archived-unmerged WI07 bundle as immutable read-only source evidence; do not copy it into this successor.
Replay only the reviewed documentation, validators, tests, and generated capability/documentation projections onto current main.
Preserve the corrective baseline regression and the unchanged 75 percent changed-critical coverage threshold.
Use Standard governance and focused documentation verification rather than Release-level checks unless automatic routing proves a stronger route is required.
intent.rationale: A clean successor from current main resolves archive identity collisions while retaining the already-reviewed WI07 product payload and fresh source-bound verification.

evidence: README.md, README.ja.md, and README.zh-CN.md expose exactly seven readme-section markers
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused README-section and link-resolution mutations in tests/test_docs_metadata.py.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run positive repository validation and negative metadata vocabulary mutations.
